title: Wastewater Microbiome Analysis by 16S rRNA Amplicon Sequencing in Major Egyptian Treatment Plants
description: This project provides a detailed characterization of bacterial community composition before and after treatment in five major wastewater treatment plants across Egypt by 16S rRNA amplicon sequencing of the V3-V4 region. By providing comprehensive insights into microbial diversity, it aims to contribute to the safe reuse of treated wastewater and to mitigate potential environmental impacts.
center: Cairo University, Faculty of Veterinary Medicine
